patch_artifact_root_semantics: Patch artifacts consumed by nrg_dev_apply_patch must resolve under the configured studies workspace, be regular files, and not escape through symlinks.
allowlist_semantics: Entry ending '/' matches that directory and descendants; an exact entry matches exactly one file; an entry containing glob metacharacters (* ? [ ]) uses fnmatch glob semantics. Denylist and self_protected_paths override allowlist.
self_protection_semantics: Ordinary nrg_dev_* transactions must not rewrite the guarded-development trusted computing base. Changes to this security boundary require a separate out-of-band security bootstrap (or a future stronger security_boundary transaction class), not an ordinary development transaction.
test_execution_trust: Test commands are fixed/normalized by trusted profiles; subprocess arguments are never passed through a shell; environment is sanitized; CWD/PYTHONPATH are bound to the isolated worktree. Candidate source state is checked before and after the test; a changed candidate state yields integrity_failed and is not bound as validation. Nevertheless candidate Python executed by pytest has the permissions of the local user; this is NOT an OS sandbox. Human confirmation before a test profile is a real trust boundary.
commit_validation_policy: Commit requires current-tree diff_check=pass AND at least one current-tree pytest profile (targeted_pytest or full_pytest) with pass; a current-tree fail or integrity_failed result blocks commit; environment_blocked is not a passing substitute.
